access_notes: Tutorial reading is open. Applying a technique is not a complete accessibility audit or conformance claim; test with the relevant tools and users.
starter_task: Review a fictional training page for text alternatives, headings and form labels; explain one remaining accessibility question.

evidence.title: W3C WAI accessibility tutorials — official learning information
evidence.support: Official tutorials connect common web tasks to accessibility techniques and examples.
